mapper.sql: b.booking_id, b.member_id, b.course_id, b.booking_time, b.status, b.remark, m.member_name AS member_name, c.course_name AS course_name, c.course_time AS course_time, c.max_capacity AS max_capacity, c.booked_count AS booked_count, h.coach_name AS coach_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM course_booking b LEFT JOIN member m ON b.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN course c ON b.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN coach h ON c.coach_id = h.coach_id ORDER BY b.booking_time DESC

SELECT FROM course_booking b LEFT JOIN member m ON b.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN course c ON b.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN coach h ON c.coach_id = h.coach_id WHERE b.booking_id = #{bookingId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_booking WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_booking(member_id, course_id, status, remark) VALUES(#{memberId}, #{courseId}, 1, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE course_booking SET status = 0 WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId}
